text:
GWWO Architects is seeking a Project Architect/Project Manager with 8–12 years of experience to join our K–12
education team. This position offers the opportunity to expand your expertise, strengthen your leadership skills, and
contribute to innovative educational environments.
Primary Responsibilities:
■ Work under the direction of the PIC and Team Leader
to design and deliver innovative design solutions for
our education projects
■ Collaborate with other designers and managers in the
studio to maintain the firm’s design principles
■ Implement the firm’s design process and encourage
the use of available innovation tools to achieve the
firm’s design and brand objectives
■ Demonstrate knowledge of resources and materials
and their application
■ Take responsibility for ensuring codes, regulations,
and industry standards are applied correctly
■ Promote technical and professional excellence
throughout the team
■ Mentor and provide guidance to project team
members to achieve objectives
■ Stay informed about industry trends and challenges
in professional practice, regulatory compliance, and
construction
■ Present designs to clients and continue to develop
and refine presentation skills
Essential/Required Qualifications:
■ 8+ years of experience in the industry; education
project experience required
■ NAAB-Accredited Degree in Architecture
■ Proficiency in Revit Architecture
■ Understanding of construction documents, including
technical specifications and document coordination
■ Strong building technology and problem-solving skills
■ Ability to work well within a team structure
■ Excellent time management and team organizational
skills
■ Quality-minded and self-motivated
■ Fluency with Office 365 software
■ Physical requirements: Visual review of documents,
typing, traversing construction sites on foot
Strongly Preferred Qualifications:
■ Architecture License
■ Strong design sense and demonstrated design
abilities
■ Excellent programming and planning skills
■ Experience with additional software platforms such
as Adobe Creative Suite, SketchUp, or other 3D
modeling software
The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $105,000
annually, contingent upon candidate experience and skill
set. Employees are also eligible for annual bonuses and a
comprehensive benefits package
Benefits currently offered by GWWO include a 401(k) plan
with employer contributions; medical, dental, and vision
insurance; pre-tax medical and child-care reimbursement
plans; paid professional organization memberships
and professional development opportunities; in-house
educational seminars; free parking; a generous vacation
and absence policy; partially paid FMLA leave; and
thirteen paid holidays (including the days between
Christmas and New Year’s).
Please apply through our website.
